description: React component for rendering detailed test result view, including errors, steps, image diffs, screenshots, traces, videos, and attachments in a test reporting UI.

classes.name: ImageDiffWithAnchors
classes.description: Extends ImageDiff with an array of anchor strings for linking purposes.

classes.name: StepTreeItem
classes.description: React component for rendering individual test steps with nested children.

methods.name: groupImageDiffs
methods.description: Groups image attachments into diffs with expected, actual, previous, and diff categories, returning an array of diffs with anchors.

methods.name: pickDiffForError
methods.description: Selects an image diff related to an error message if it pertains to screenshot or snapshot mismatch.
